name: MonarchAiSummaryCard
title: AiSummaryCard
wrapsNative: MonarchCard (androidx.compose.material3.Surface) composing MonarchAiGeneratedBadge, MonarchAiMarkdown, MonarchAiSourceList, MonarchBanner, MonarchButton and MonarchSkeleton; android.text.format.DateUtils for the age
summary: A model-written summary of a record or a page on a card: the summary as Markdown, when it was written, its sources and a Refresh action, with generating, stale and error states, always marked as an AI summary.
whenToUse: At the top of a record or a page (an account, a deal, a long thread) where a model summarises what the person would otherwise read in full, and where the summary can go stale.
whenNotToUse: For a reply in a conversation, use the conversation message components. For a single highlighted insight, use MonarchAiInsightCallout or a banner.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAiSummaryCard(title: String, summary: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, status: MonarchAiSummaryCardStatus = MonarchAiSummaryCardStatus.Ready, refreshing: Boolean = false, generatedAt: Long? = null, now: Long? = null, sources: List<MonarchAiSourcePart> = emptyList(), error: String? = null, onRefresh: (() -> Unit)? = null, onOpenSource: ((MonarchAiSourcePart) -> Unit)? = null, onOpenLink: ((url: String) -> Unit)? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, refreshIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable FlowRowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiSummaryCardLabels = MonarchAiSummaryCardLabels())
enum class MonarchAiSummaryCardStatus { Ready, Generating, Stale, Error }

class MonarchAiSummaryCardLabels(aiSummary: String? = null, refresh: String? = null, generated: ((relativeTime: String) -> String)? = null, generating: String? = null, updated: String? = null, stale: String? = null, error: String? = null, empty: String? = null, sources: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: What is summarised, for example "Account summary". A heading.

options.name: summary
options.description: The summary as Markdown, rendered by MonarchAiMarkdown as untrusted model output. Blank while there is none.

options.name: status
options.description: Ready, Generating (placeholder or busy Refresh), Stale (a warning banner) or Error (an error banner).

options.name: refreshing
options.description: A refresh is running: Refresh shows a spinner and the start and end are announced.

options.name: generatedAt
options.description: When the summary was written, in epoch milliseconds (UTC). Shown as "Generated 3 hours ago"; TalkBack reads the date and time.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for generatedAt, in epoch milliseconds. null uses the current time when composed.

options.name: sources
options.description: The documents or records the summary was written from, listed by MonarchAiSourceList under "Sources".

options.name: error
options.description: A detail shown under the error title when status is Error.

options.name: onRefresh
options.description: Adds Refresh, which asks for a new summary.

options.name: onOpenSource
options.description: Opens a source, for example in a preview sheet; without it MonarchAiSourceList opens a safe URL through the system.

options.name: onOpenLink
options.description: Opens a link in the summary; passed to MonarchAiMarkdown.

options.name: icon
options.description: The AI mark before "AI summary". Monarch bundles no icons; the words carry the meaning.

options.name: actions
options.description: More actions after the age line, for example Copy or Open in assistant.

states.name: ready
states.description: The summary, its sources and its age.

states.name: generating
states.description: Without a summary: "Generating summary…" and three placeholder lines. With one: the summary stays and Refresh shows a spinner.

states.name: stale
states.description: A warning banner above the summary asks for a refresh.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger banner with "The summary couldn’t be generated." and the detail, announced assertively; the body is empty.

appearance: MonarchCard's surface fill, default border and 12dp corners. The AI badge in the AI colors above the title in default text, the age in muted caption text, the warning and error banners in their tone colors. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: A product pattern, experimental until a Rook app adopts it, built only from Monarch parts. The web marks the summary with a bot glyph and an eyebrow; Android uses MonarchAiGeneratedBadge with the label "AI summary" and the glyph as an optional slot, since Monarch bundles no icons. The web's heading levels do not exist in Android semantics, so headingLevel is not offered; the title is a heading. The web dims the previous summary while refreshing; Android does not dim with alpha and shows the spinner on Refresh and an announcement instead. The web's sources list is a plain ordered list of links; Android reuses MonarchAiSourceList (numbered, collapsible). Dates are epoch milliseconds and the relative time comes from DateUtils, so it is not updated live: recompose with a new now to refresh it. There is no iOS equivalent yet.
accessibility: The title is a heading; "AI summary" is visible text read before it, so the provenance does not depend on an icon.
Refresh is a MonarchButton with a 48dp touch target; while busy it shows the loading state.
"Generating summary…" is announced politely when work starts and "Summary updated." when it ends, from a live region that is always present, so nothing is announced when the card first appears.
The error banner is announced assertively; the stale warning is not announced.
The age line reads the date and time instead of the relative phrase.
Sources are buttons in MonarchAiSourceList; links in the summary are LinkAnnotation links.
edgeCases: A blank summary while generating shows the placeholder; after an error it shows nothing but the banner.
Untrusted Markdown in the summary is rendered safely by MonarchAiMarkdown: raw HTML stays text and unsafe links are not links.
Without generatedAt and actions there is no footer.
A long title wraps; Refresh stays at the end.

examples.title: Refresh with sources
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiSummaryCard(
    title = {{title}},
    summary = {{summary}},
    generatedAt = {{generatedAt|millis}},
    now = {{now|millis}},
    sources = listOf(
        MonarchAiSourcePart(id = {{sources.0.id}}, title = {{sources.0.title}}, url = {{sources.0.url}}, kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.{{sources.0.kind|pascal}}),
        MonarchAiSourcePart(id = {{sources.1.id}}, title = {{sources.1.title}}, kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.{{sources.1.kind|pascal}}, product = {{sources.1.product}}),
    ),
    onRefresh = {},
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Bot, contentDescription = null) },
    refreshIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Retry, contentDescription = null) },
    actions = {
        MonarchButton(text = {{actionLabel}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
    },
)
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiSummaryCard(
    title = "Account summary",
    summary = "The customer renewed for another year in **January** and added two seats.\n\n- Usage is steady at about 40 active people a week.\n- One open support ticket about exports.",
    generatedAt = 1_795_003_200_000L,
    now = 1_795_014_000_000L,
    sources = listOf(
        MonarchAiSourcePart(id = "notes", title = "Renewal call notes", url = "https://example.com/notes/renewal", kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.Doc),
        MonarchAiSourcePart(id = "ticket", title = "Ticket 2041: CSV export", kind = MonarchAiSourceKind.Record, product = "Support"),
    ),
    onRefresh = {},
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Bot, contentDescription = null) },
    refreshIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Retry, contentDescription = null) },
    actions = {
        MonarchButton(text = "Open in assistant", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
    },
)

examples.title: A summary that could not be generated
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAiSummaryCard(
    title = "Deal summary",
    summary = "",
    status = MonarchAiSummaryCardStatus.Error,
    error = "The model did not answer in time.",
    onRefresh = {},
)
